安全带为什么要贴住身体？: Why must a seat belt fit snugly?
车和人原本一起向前。车开始减速，身体仍有保持原来运动的趋势，这叫惯性。需要安全带: The car and its passengers start out moving together. When the car slows, a body tends to keep its previous motion: that is inertia. A belt or child seat must exert a force to slow the body with the car.
坐在座位上的抽象成人模型，肩带斜跨肩部和胸前，腰带低贴髋部；虚线右箭头代表原先运: An abstract seated adult model. The shoulder belt crosses the shoulder and chest; the lap belt sits low on the hips. A dashed rightward arrow marks the original direction of motion.
成人佩带位置示意；不显示碰撞或伤害。虚线箭头是原先运动方向，不是惯性力。: Adult belt-position illustration; no crash or injury is shown. The dashed arrow shows earlier motion, not an inertia force.
安全带的作用分散在较结实的身体部位。与身体直接撞上车内硬物相比，约束系统配合车辆: A belt spreads its action over stronger body regions. Compared with hitting a hard interior surface, restraints work with the vehicle's energy-absorbing structure to spread slowing over more time and distance.
贴合才来得及帮忙。不能故意放松带子来“延长时间”，也不能把肩带放在腋下或背后。: A snug fit lets the belt help in time. Never add slack to 'give more time', or put the shoulder belt under an arm or behind the back.

匀减速示意取 v = 速度 ÷ 3.6，反应距离 dᵣ = vtᵣ，制动距离 d: The constant-deceleration model uses v = speed in km/h ÷ 3.6, reaction distance dᵣ = vtᵣ and braking distance dᵦ = v²/(2a). For the same surface and deceleration, doubling speed doubles reaction distance and quadruples braking distance. Total stopping distance need not quadruple. The car never reverses after stopping.
惯性是物体保持运动状态的性质，不是额外向前的力。乘员减速需要真实的外力；本页不计: Inertia is a property of maintaining motion, not an extra forward force. Slowing a passenger requires a real external force. This page does not calculate body loads, deformation or injury. The impulse relation Faverage × Δt = Δp explains how spreading the same momentum change over more time can reduce average force; it does not predict peak loads or a protection percentage.
理想无滑动轮胎接地点的静摩擦不因“车在前进”就自动变成滑动摩擦；它把路面对轮胎的: At an ideal no-slip tire contact, static friction does not become sliding friction merely because the car moves; it transmits the road's action to the car. Conventional friction brakes convert mechanical energy mainly into internal energy at the brakes. Real tires deform and can slip locally. ABS modulates braking to reduce wheel lock, but does not guarantee shorter stops on every surface. Electric and hybrid vehicles may also recover some energy through regenerative braking.
儿童应在产品允许的身高、体重范围内尽可能保持后向；前向座椅继续使用内置安全带，并: Keep children rear-facing as long as the product's height and weight limits allow. Use the harness in a forward-facing seat, with a tether or the specified anti-rotation device as both manuals require. A booster positions the vehicle's lap-and-shoulder belt over the shoulder, chest and hips. Transitions depend on eligibility, the ability to sit properly throughout the trip and actual belt fit. Never place a rear-facing seat in front of an active passenger airbag.

肩带贴合肩部和胸前，避开颈部与脸，不能滑到肩膀外。肩带不是一条可以藏起来的带子。: The shoulder belt fits across the shoulder and chest, away from the neck and face without slipping off the shoulder. It must not be tucked out of the way.
